fixes.explanation: Family, friend? I know a guy who can turn one cousin's promotion into a forty-minute speech, so I get the pull. But family didn't make this list. The LORD names the wise man in his wisdom, the strong man in his strength and the wealthy man in his riches (Jeremiah 9:23). Three men, three bragging rights, and not one of them is family. Nice swing, though!

SPEECH?! Baker, you swung at that blank like it owed you money, and I respect it. But that word isn't in the verse. The LORD says the whole house of Israel is uncircumcised in heart (Jeremiah 9:26). Heart goes in the blank. Speech can sit this one out and cool on the rack.

problems.problem: The family-brag line is still generic and lacks Papa Dorin's distinctive comic voice.
The explanation still mostly repeats the answer, with little distinctive personality beyond the capitalization and apron reference.
